title: Enhancing Accuracy in Breast Density Assessment Using Deep Learning: A Multicentric, Multi-Reader Study
summary: On 72 reference-labeled mammography studies (122 studies collected across three centers), the algorithm achieved accuracy 0.819, F1 0.798, and kappa 0.708, matching or exceeding individual radiologists in four comparisons; accuracy differences were not statistically significant. Two experienced radiologists established reference labels; output was compared with five radiologists of varying experience. Retrospective, modest sample, with industry-affiliated developers; no downstream screening or patient-outcome benefit was tested.
ai_technology: A deep-learning automatic detection algorithm assigns BI-RADS mammographic breast-density categories from full-field digital mammography images.
